items.title: Claude Code v2.1.173
items.summary:
- Fixed Fable 5 model names with a `[1m]` suffix not being normalized — Fable 5 includes 1M context by default, so the suffix is now stripped automatically
- Fixed a spurious "sandbox dependencies missing" startup warning on Windows when sandbox was enabled in settings

- Added a search bar when browsing a marketplace's plugins in `/plugin`
- Added `model` attribute to the `claude_code.lines_of_code.count` OTEL metric

items.title: What we learned mapping a year’s worth of AI-enabled cyber threats
items.summary: As AI transforms the nature of and methods behind cyberattacks, how well do the techniques and frameworks used by the security community hold up? In a new report, we seek to answer that question.
items.title_ko: 1년간의 AI 기반 사이버 위협을 매핑하며 배운 것
items.summary_ko: AI가 사이버 공격의 양상과 수법을 바꾸는 가운데, 기존 보안 커뮤니티의 기법·프레임워크가 얼마나 잘 버티는지 새 보고서로 정리했습니다.

items.title: Anthropic confidentially submits draft S-1 to the SEC
items.summary: Anthropic has confidentially submitted a draft S-1 registration statement to the Securities and Exchange Commission
items.title_ko: Anthropic, SEC에 기밀 S-1 초안 제출

items.title: Introducing Claude Opus 4.8
